recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a new, broader profile-page download policy beyond the links implemented for FHIR-13255; that would be a new requirement, not a missing application of this Published issue.
issue_request: FHIR-13255 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core request to add downloadable alternate-definition links to profile pages, using the vital signs panel profile as the example and asking for Master Definition XML/JSON and validation-format links.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 12608, represented in git by 58ac284e01124f95b84e785a17f699499df849ad, which changed the profile page template from a generic other-representations sentence to Alternate definitions: Master Definition (XML, JSON). Later repository refactoring moved that template from source/template-profile.html to tools/templates/template-profile.html without removing the FHIR-13255 link text.
additional_context: The current build scope still includes Observation as an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and source/observation/implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml includes StructureDefinition/vitalspanel. Current tools/templates/template-profile.html still emits the requested alternate-definition links for generated profile pages, and the current CI build vitalspanel page renders links to vitalspanel.profile.xml.html, vitalspanel.profile.json.html, and vitalspanel.sch. Bounded Jira/community searches found no later Jira or Confluence decision reversing this application; Zulip search found only a tracker bot mention and later user guidance that the alternate-definition links are how to find structure definition downloads.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current profile template and the generated current vitalspanel profile page already satisfy the applied issue.
